mechanism_narrative: Sustained quarterly growth in GDPC1 (demand) predicts positive S&P 500 20-day returns as expanding demand boosts equity valuations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day returns in expanding demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points triggers positive returns by signaling improved labor market conditions and reduced inflation expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day returns fail to rise when UNRATE crosses above 4.5%, or positive returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.05) during the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS (monetary tightening) and CPIAUCSL (inflation) predicts negative returns due to contractionary policy conflicting with inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: 20-day returns do not decline when FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL exhibit the specified joint behavior, or IC > 0.03 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 4.0% amplifies positive returns by easing monetary policy during market overvaluation.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, FEDFUNDS decline does not consistently produce positive returns, or IC < 0.03 over 2 years.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent quarterly growth in GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) exceeding prior trends signals overexpansion, leading to negative 60-day returns as market corrects.
failure_condition: 60-day returns remain non-negative despite concurrent GDPC1 and INDPRO growth, or IC > 0.03 over the period.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly PAYEMS surge above 180,000 indicates strong labor demand, which predicts positive 5-day returns as employment optimism boosts market sentiment.
failure_condition: 5-day returns fail to rise when PAYEMS exceeds 180,000, or returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL crossing above 320 (inflation acceleration) triggers negative 60-day returns as investors anticipate higher interest rates dampening growth.
failure_condition: 60-day returns do not decline when CPIAUCSL crosses above 320, or IC > 0.03 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous UNRATE decline below 4.0% and PAYEMS exceeding 160,000 (tight labor market) predicts positive 5-day returns via strong employment and low unemployment.
failure_condition: 5-day returns fail to rise when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS > 160,000, or IC < 0.03 over the period.
